en: Install the eSIM profile before you fly.
target: 出发前安装 eSIM 描述文件。
suggestion: 出发前安装 eSIM 配置文件。
explanation: «描述文件» is the iOS term for configuration profiles (VPN, MDM, beta), not for an eSIM; an iPhone reader may look in Settings → VPN与设备管理 for it. The eSIM profile is usually «eSIM 配置文件» (or simply «安装 eSIM», as the rest of the site writes). Terminology rule; not in the glossary, so confidence is moderate.
rule: terminology: eSIM profile ≠ iOS configuration profile

explanation: «设置» is also the name of the Settings app (platform-labels: 设置), so «iPhone 设置» can read as «iPhone Settings» rather than a link to the iPhone setup guide. Also in ui:site.compatAndroid («Android 设置» → «Android 安装指南»).
